title: go-to-market-misc-assets-inventory
body:
Overview:
A quick, messy inventory of miscellaneous go-to-market assets dropped into the shared drive. Purpose: intermediate staging area for marketing files, ad-hoc creative, and odd one-offs that don’t have a tidy home yet.

Notes / context:
- This is not the canonical brand repo (see Confluence/company-brand-assets-10234) but often contains working files, exported slides, and experimental banners.
- Naming conventions are inconsistent; use this doc to track what we have before a cleanup.
- Files below were collected by Maya/Tony during Q4 asset sprint. Some duplicates likely.

Inventory (filename -> short notes):
- redwood-launch-hero-v3.psd  -> source PSD, layer names messy, used for hero banner A/B.
- hero-banner-final-1200x600.png -> exported for campaign-20251123, optimized for web but may need retina version.
- twitter-card-2025-11-30.png -> cropped variant, text overlaps logo on mobile.
- customer-quotes-slide-v2.pptx -> slide deck w/ customer logo placeholders (ask legal for logo approvals).
- experimental-logo-anim.gif -> small loop, questionable frame rate. Keep for social only.
- product-comparison-sheet-draft.xlsx -> sheet w/ competitors list, out-of-date pricing column.
- keynote-proposal-jan-2026.key -> early draft for investor event; has speaker notes with TODOs.
- badge-sizes.zip -> export set (16/32/64/128) but filenames are inconsistent (badge_1.png, badge_2@2x.png etc).
- old-swag-prints.pdf -> vendor-ready files but check margins; vendor updated bleed spec since 2023.
- naming-rules-2024.txt -> tiny doc with legacy naming rules (may conflict with new scheme).
- ad-copy-variants.txt -> many short lines, A/B copy, includes versions flagged "too salesy".
- misc-screenshots/ (folder) -> assorted PNGs from product late-stage demos; labeled by timestamp only.

Immediate TODOs (short-term):
1) Standardize hero assets: create a "hero-master" naming and export set (Maya) - target: 2026-01-20.
2) Confirm legal approvals for customer logos used in customer-quotes-slide-v2.pptx (Ethan) - tag: legal-request-2026.
3) Consolidate badge-sizes.zip into badge-master.zip with consistent filenames (Sofia) - quick script may help.
4) Audit old-swag-prints.pdf bleed/margins before sending to vendor (Maya).

Random observations / noise (will probably be cleaned up):
- There are at least 3 "final" assets for the hero banner; naming includes "final", "final2", and "really-final". Classic.
- Some files contain placeholder lorem ipsum in slides and are missing alt text.
- A couple of PNGs were exported at 72dpi but should be 150+ for print.

Links / references:
- Canonical brand assets: confluence/company-brand-assets-10234
- Campaign plan (WIP): linear/PM-4123
- Example PR that touched images: github/pr-1987-brand-assets

Attachment stubs in this folder (refer to actual drive):
- 20251123-campaign-brief.pdf (attachment, 1.2MB)
- final-hero-slices.zip (attachment, 8 files)

Cleanup plan (stretch):
- Feb 2026 cleanup sprint: export canonical versions, update Confluence index, archive duplicates into /archive-old-assets/ with timestamped manifest.
- Consider a short script to detect duplicate image dimensions and flag common "final" suffixes.

Unresolved questions (notes-to-self):
- Who owns the "social animations" category now? (ops or brand)
- Do we keep legacy swag prints for historical reference or purge?

If you add files here, please append a single-line entry to this doc with filename -> one-line note and initials. Keeps the chaos marginally tolerable.

-- Maya T.
